transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well… I came in because I lost my temper at one of the younger volunteers. It was over something stupid, a crooked tablecloth, and I just blew up. I don’t usually talk to people like that, so it shook me a bit.
Has this kind of outburst happened to you before?
Not really, no. That’s why it bothered me. I got angry over that crooked tablecloth and snapped at the young volunteer, and I don’t usually talk to people like that.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
I don’t think so. I’m usually pretty careful about what I say and do. That outburst felt out of character for me.
Do you have any habits or rituals that you feel compelled to do over and over?
No, I don’t think so. I have my routines like anyone my age, but nothing I feel forced to do over and over.
Do you often have thoughts that keep repeating in your mind and are difficult to get rid of?

Yes... not all the time, but it does happen. Out of nowhere I’ll hear that man’s rough voice in my head, or I’ll see that donation envelope hitting the ground. It can come up even when I’m just sitting at my kitchen table, and it’s hard to shake off.
Are the repeating thoughts in your mind related to the incident where you lost your temper at the volunteer?

Yes, they are. It’s mostly tied to that incident. I’ll suddenly hear that man’s rough voice again, or picture the donation envelope hitting the ground. It can happen even when I’m just sitting quietly at my kitchen table.
Have these repeating thoughts been causing you a lot of distress or interfering with your daily life?
Yes, it has. I’m not keeping up with the Día de los Muertos organizing like I usually do, and that bothers me. And I’ve stopped going to card nights for now… I just don’t feel steady around people.
Did something traumatic happen to you around the time of the incident with the volunteer?
I’m not sure I’d call it traumatic, doctor. I mean, the incident itself shook me up, but I can’t think of some other big thing that happened around that time.
Have you been having any physical symptoms like headaches or trouble sleeping since the incident with the volunteer?
Yes, mostly trouble sleeping. Since the robbery, I get into bed tired, but then I just lie there listening for noises. And I wake up before dawn feeling like I hardly slept at all.
Did you experience or witness something very frightening or disturbing around the time of the incident with the volunteer?
No, I don’t think so. I didn’t see anything like that happen around then. It was the situation with the volunteer that upset me, but nothing else frightening that I can point to.
Have you been avoiding places, people, or activities that remind you of the incident with the volunteer?
Yes. I’ve been going the long way around so I don’t have to pass the bank. And I haven’t gone into the festival storage room either—it just brings the whole thing too close.
How long have you been experiencing these repeating thoughts and trouble sleeping?
It’s been about a week now, I’d say. Pretty much since the robbery outside the bank.
Are there any other places, people, or activities that you've been avoiding since the incident?

Mostly those two things. I’ve been avoiding walking past the bank, taking the longer route instead. And I still haven’t gone back into the festival storage room, because it just makes it feel too close again.
Have you felt like you're having trouble functioning in your daily life or with relationships since this incident happened?
Yes, some. I haven’t been keeping up with organizing the Día de los Muertos event like I usually do. And I’ve stopped going to card nights too… I just don’t feel steady around people right now.
Are there any other activities or situations that you've been avoiding because they remind you of what happened outside the bank?
Just those things, mainly. I take the long way so I don’t have to pass the bank, and I still haven’t gone into the festival storage room. It just brings it all too close again.
How long have you been avoiding the bank and the festival storage room?
About a week now. It started right after the robbery outside the bank, and I just haven’t been able to make myself go by there or into that storage room since.
How much longer do you think you'll keep avoiding the bank and the festival storage room?

I don’t really know. I keep telling myself I’ll go by there soon, but right now I’m still taking the long way around the bank, and I haven’t been able to go into that storage room. It just makes the whole thing feel too close again.
Have you been avoiding other things besides the bank and the festival storage room?

No, not really other things. It’s mainly been going near the bank, so I take the long way, and that festival storage room. I just haven’t been able to go in there because it brings everything back too close.
